parent_objective: audit fresh metric-selected measured-validation result before interpretation
blocked_by: M2445 executed rows need audit before current-sim interpretation
old-row diagnostic soft success and fresh soft-boundary execution disagree and must be classified
supersedes: claiming current-sim verdict directly from implementation summary
treating old-row relabel soft success as fresh measured execution

public_gates: M2446 must audit M2445 summary, episode rows, aggregate rows, and decision rows
M2446 must verify complete 5250 episode coverage and zero failure/validation/contract/guardrail failures
M2446 must classify measured actual-success, hard-offtrack, and soft-violation rates without ranking candidates or controllers
M2446 must explain the relationship between M2438 old-row diagnostic soft success and M2445 fresh soft-boundary execution
M2446 must choose localization, synthesis, bounded scenario-quality route, stop, or another explicit next blocker
M2446 must not rerun measured rollout, repair, train, rank candidates/controllers, select winners, or make paper/FW-vs-GRU/level3-self-ID/training-repair verdict claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not rerun measured policy rollout
do not inject hidden or oracle actor features
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits fresh metric-selected measured-validation evidence and decides the next bounded route
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: measured-validation result audit only; no rerun, repair, training, ranking, winner selection, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, level3 self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, or training-repair claim
stop_condition: stop if M2445 coverage is incomplete
stop if M2445 has guardrail or actor-contract violations
stop if audit cannot explain old diagnostic relabel versus fresh execution mismatch
stop if the next route would be another old-row relabel without new evidence
fallback_plan: route to localization if M2445 artifact is accepted but outcome remains blocker-dominated
route to implementation repair if artifacts are incomplete
synthesize or stop if task-boundary metric redesign no longer supports progress

allowed_updates: M2446 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the audit
next_stage_criteria: M2445 artifact is accepted or rejected
raw measured outcome is classified without overclaiming
a bounded non-ranking next route is selected or the route is stopped

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2446 audits task-quality measured results and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2446; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If M2445 remains hard-offtrack dominated, record the negative result and route to localization/synthesis rather than direct repair or training.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, candidate-family ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: audits fresh executed measured-validation rows rather than another old-row relabel
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can clarify current-sim task-quality blocker distance; cannot establish paper verdict
must_synthesize_if: audit cannot choose localization, synthesis, stop, or bounded next route
result is used to claim paper/self-ID verdict

hypothesis: Auditing M2445 can classify the fresh metric-selected measured-validation result and choose a bounded next route without rerun, repair, training, ranking, or paper/self-ID verdict claims.
success_criteria: M2445 summary and rows are audited
measured actual-success, hard-offtrack, and soft-violation rates are classified without ranking
old diagnostic relabel versus fresh execution mismatch is addressed
a bounded non-ranking next route is selected or the route is stopped
no rerun repair training ranking winner paper/FW-vs-GRU/self-ID/training-repair claim is made
failure_criteria: M2446 ranks candidate families or controllers
M2446 selects a winner or promotes a checkpoint
M2446 treats M2445 as paper-level result without further evidence
M2446 makes FW-vs-GRU, level3 self-ID, or training-repair verdict claims
decision_rule: M2446 passes if it audits M2445 and selects a bounded non-ranking next route or stops without rerun, repair, training, ranking, winner selection, or paper/FW-vs-GRU/self-ID/training-repair claims.
